title: Tell Me Something Good
prompt_text:
Create a vertical 1080x1920 collectible 1974 Billboard Hot 100 chart card.
Style: high-detail illustrated print poster from 1974, worn paper grain, subtle ink imperfections, ornate border, period-accurate 1970s typography.
Do NOT use any real person's likeness or recognizable face.

Top banner text: "Billboard Hot 100 - Week Ending 1974-08-17".
Large rank display: "#4".
Title: "Tell Me Something Good".
Artist: "Rufus".
Include small fact blocks: "Weeks on Chart: 10" and "Peak Position: 4".

Artwork: symbolic / atmospheric illustration inspired by the song's mood, not literal portraits.
Composition should feel like a real printed artifact from 1974.

No modern UI, no neon glow boxes, no geometric template panels.
